digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / LLM plan review criteria
propositions: A new advisory code-grounded criterion must detect when a plan asserts a named module provides a capability that the module lacks
A new advisory code-grounded criterion must detect when a plan asserts a capability must be built but the named module already provides it
The criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM, CODEBASE_GROUNDED, and AGENT_TIER registries with routing entry and rubric prompt to avoid validation failures
The criterion must integrate into the four-pass finder/verifier/decide/coach machinery and auto-flow into the standing effectiveness recorder with zero per-criterion wiring
A bounded sanity fixture set must verify the probe fires on the three E1-verified miss cases (dc58, db7b, 5886) with recall >=2/3 and advisories never block
The criterion ships as advisory posture with future promotion to blocking gated on dogfood effectiveness measurement per the advisory-to-blocking promotion protocol
